# `auth.password.change`

Change the account password

Requires a fresh session. Revokes every session including the current one.

- Method and path: `POST /settings/security/password`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie auth password change`
- MCP: `auth_password_change`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$schema` | body | no | `string` |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `current` | body | yes | `string` |
| `next` | body | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`unauthorized`, `validation`, plus the framework problems.
